opening.argument: The speaker promotes a trading platform by presenting Bitcoin earnings as available without viewers doing the trading themselves. He says, “it's a trading platform where you do not have to do no trading,” describes being able to “let my Bitcoin grow,” and claims the platform gets him Bitcoin whether the market rises or falls. The description expressly asks whether viewers want passive income and directs interested people to contact him for a link. Joining is urged as the way to start getting Bitcoin, although the evidence does not establish actual earnings, transfers, transaction outcomes, or where the link leads.
